hook: Telangana readies *11* new policies for its Global Summit
hook_b: Telangana readies *11* new policies for its Global Summit
tldr: Telangana will unveil 11 policies at the Invest Telangana Global Summit, covering industry, IT, GCCs, data centres, chips, AVGC and offshore campuses of foreign universities.

beats.what: The State is preparing 11 policies covering industry, IT and higher education for the Invest Telangana Global Summit, The Hindu reported.
beats.why: They follow the Telangana Rising Vision 2047, which aims at a $3 trillion economy, unveiled at last year's summit.
beats.care: Labour-intensive sectors like textiles, footwear and leather get special policies aimed at large-scale jobs; IT gets ICT Policy 2.0 plus GCC, data centre and chip policies.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The full list: Industrial 2.0, Footwear and Leather, Textiles and Apparel 2.0, Aerospace-Defence-Space, Logistics, ICT 2.0, GCC, Data Centres 2.0, Electronics and Semiconductors, AVGC, and Foreign Offshore Campus. Incentive details are not out yet.

qs: Which of these policies are new, and which are 2.0 updates?
What incentives will foreign universities get?

facts.t: Telangana Rising Vision 2047 aims for a *$3 trillion* economy by 2047.

viz.verdict: Five policies each for industry and IT/tech; one for higher education.
